notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.notes:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on[b] July 18th.[/b]
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

[h1]Early Access and Beyond[/h1]
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

[b]We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.[/b]

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: Die Young is out on PS4 & a new PC 1.2.5 Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Die Young is now available on PlayStation 4[/h1]
[url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001][img]https://i.imgur.com/XibGgcm.png[/img][/url]
Happy New Year! 2020 has been a long year full of unpleasant surprises, but we wanted to start 2021 strong and with [b]two pleasant surprises.[/b]

[b]Firstly[/b], Die Young is now available on the [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001?utm_source=mail_t&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Weekend_20210116]PlayStation Store.[/url] We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now. 

Die Young is out now on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001?utm_source=mail_t&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Weekend_20210116]PS4[/url] in English, German, Hungarian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Spanish, Turkish (screen languages). For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on [b]PS5[/b], your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Although this game is playable on PS5, some features available on PS4 may be absent.

Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

[b]Secondly[/b], we have not forgotten about our PC fans. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url] just got updated on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Steam[/url]. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v1.5.0 - Full release incoming!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29067535/33618dd4e36960ed1127ede1f17832e33c789875.png[/img]

Bring in some friends and unlock the true potential of [b]Stayin' Alive[/b]! In this version:
[list]
	[*][b]Play up to 8 vs 8![/b]
	[*]Four new Suicider characters!
	[*]Hospital map is now fully open!
	[*]Room host can change map and match time directly from Room menu
	[*]Players will always return to Room menu after a match
	[*]Automatic match start is now delayed by some seconds, when a room is full
	[*]Nicer room information box in the Room menu
	[*]Improved AIs behavior (searching items, navigating, etc)
	[*]Savior AIs will drop their passive power-ups after a while, instead of keeping them forever
	[*]Improved item spawning criteria
	[*]Fixed a couple of major bugs when using the Blowgun
	[*]More bug fixing and improvements here and there
[/list]
Time to go all in! You can now choose to play with up to 8 players per team, included AIs like before.
Hospital map will now open up to all four floors, depending by the number of players in a room (when playing 8 vs 8, maps will always be fully open).

Next, we decided to drop the concept of [i]"Single round"[/i], [i]"Multiple rounds"[/i] and [i]"Map rotation"[/i] for a clearer experience. From now on the host will be able to change map and time in the Room menu, and after every match all players will be sent back to the Room screen.

[h1]Full release coming soon![/h1]
[b]We are going out of Early Access in a few weeks![/b] We will have just a couple more updates before that day. After that, we will continue supporting the game with fixes and some more extra content. :)

This is all for today's update. Thanks for playing and stay tuned! ;)

notes.title: April development update
notes.notes:
Hello players! We have been a bit silent because the lead programmer was ill for two weeks (me ç_ç), but now we are back on track. :)

We have teased the [b]Museum[/b] map for long enough and it's finally time to release it, so expect it for this week. In the meantime, a new compact map for frantic games is already in the works!

For the next updates we want to fix some underlying stuff like AI behavior and item spawn criteria, other than the usual dose of bug fixing. We always read the discussions so remember to post there if you encounter any kind of problem.

Last but not least, we want to increase the number of players from 4 vs 4 to 8 vs 8! Large maps with variable layout like the Hospital and the Museum will benefit from this.

Stay tuned and thanks for playing!

notes.title: February development update
notes.notes:
Hello players!
Just checking in to summarize what we are up to. Before revealing the new map (happening soon!), we are going to update the game with a couple of things some of you asked for.

[h1]Player stats and ranking[/h1]
This new menu page will list game stats (such as total game time, favorite tools, etc.), plus showing a personal medal and ranking based on your level. Brag with your opponents!
Later in the development, experience points will not only affect your ranking; high levels will unlock special items to customize your character. Keep in mind that customization is still a big work in progress!

[h1]Control mapping[/h1]
Exactly what you'd expect: map controls freely both for mouse/keyboard and joypad.

[h1]OSX support[/h1]
Apple computers will no longer be safe from [i]Stayin' Alive[/i].

We plan to roll out this update at the beginning of the next week, but we are trying to squeeze it in this weekend.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: Update v1.0.0
notes.notes:
Say hello to version [b]ONE[/b] of Stayin' Alive! Here's the changelog:
[list]
	[*]Fixed getting stuck in crafting animation
	[*]Fixed disabled audio when playing as Client
	[*]Fixed missing music when joining a started match
	[*]Improved logic when joining a match
	[*]Fixed various syncing bugs
	[*]More smaller bugs fixed
[/list]
We managed to fix many sync problems by changing the logic of how a player joins a match. Now, when joining a started match, the player will replace any bot that is [b]not[/b] in a special condition (like dying, crafting, sedated, ecc). If all the bots are "busy" in that moment, the game will just wait for the first one to free up.
This is an elegant solution that makes things way easier to sync, and it's nicer for players.

EDIT: now that v1.0.0 is out, more players are playing and more bugs are spawning. :D
Of course we already found some! In the next days we will do everything to fix what's possible before the Christmas and New Year's Eve holidays.

See you next update!

notes.title: Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello players! A new update awaits our brave saviors and suiciders:
[list]
	[*]Added basic support for commonly used joypads
	[*]Better handling of connection errors in the menu
	[*]It is no longer possible to kick players from the room during the start countdown
	[*]Fixed a crash when players would disconnected abruptly during a match, both due to being kicked or due to sudden connettivity issues
	[*]Suiciders can no longer grab, craft, and use objects while committing suicide, just as it should be
	[*]Puddle particles are now correctly deleted from the scene after their animation is over
	[*]Added some sound effects to the scene
	[*]More bug fixing
[/list]

[b]Button mapping[/b] (standard X360 joypad)
[list]
	[*][i]Left stick[/i] - Move
	[*][i]Right stick[/i] - Look around
	[*][i]LB[/i] - Grab or throw object with left hand
	[*][i]RB[/i] - Grab or throw object with right hand
	[*][i]LT, A[/i] - Sprint
	[*][i]X[/i] - Use object in left hand / Craft objects
	[*][i]B[/i] - Use object in right hand / Conduct wheelchair / Suicide
	[*][i]Y[/i] - Open door
	[*][i]Back[/i] - Show player list
	[*][i]Start[/i] - Open pause menu
[/list]
We are still working on joypad support and we want to extend it by the final release (for example, menu navigation is still not working with joypad control, and button mapping is not as good as we would have wanted).
As usual, we hope you are enjoying the game; we just love your gameplay videos! Reach us in the community to report bugs and talk about the game in general. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update v0.5.0
notes.notes:
A new update has been released, both for standard and [i]Demo[/i] version! Remember that you can only play against users with the same game build (but it's ok to play [i]Demo[/i] vs standard), so we recommend everyone to update as soon as possible. In this version:
[list]
	[*]Game now automatically connects to the best server depending on your location (this improves ping time)
	[*]Greatly improved menu navigation (still work in progress)
	[*][i]Settings[/i], [i]Pause[/i] and [i]Select Server[/i] pages now work fine
	[*]New, quick tutorial screens during scene loading
	[*]Fixed errors when crafting a partial [i]Stimulant cocktail[/i]
	[*]Possibily fixed random crashes when someone died by Electroshock
	[*]Suiciders can't run away from the isolation rooms anymore (they were never supposed to do that!)
	[*]Reduced both respawn time and match start time to 5 seconds
	[*]Changes and improvements to some UI graphics
	[*]Some small improvements to scenery graphics
	[*]Other minor fixes
[/list]
There are some issues that we are going to sort later, in particular:
[list]
	[*]Occasional wrong gameplay behavior due to connection failures
	[*]Joypad control is still not working
	[*]Game performance is heavier than it should be
	[*]Connection to main server and  rooms may occasionally fail without errors
[/list]
We hope you are enjoying the game; we just love your gameplay videos! Reach us in the community to report bugs and talk about the game in general. Thanks for playing!
